narrative.details:
Ah, I remember now! Mosarn is a well-respected blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. I knew I had heard his name somewhere, before.

In thanks, the Earthen Ring awarded me with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. Very good work.

Perhaps he can tell you more about the shield he crafted.

It's not much of a lead, but since we didn't get anything useful out of Reethe, it's all we have.
narrative.objectives: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Mosarn in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, you are certainly correct. This is a shield that I made.

I'm afraid there's not much more I can tell you though, adventurer. I craft so many different shields and sets of armor, I can't keep track of them all.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello there, champion. Something I can help you with?
